- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota uses "Just in Time" inventory management to deliver parts and materials to the production line as needed.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Comprehensive training is provided to Toyota employees to ensure knowledge of production systems and automotive technologies.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota is transparent about its manufacturing processes and publishes reports on quality control measures and improvements.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota has made significant changes based on customer feedback, including addressing unintended acceleration issues with a large-scale recall and implementing brake override systems.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota developed an automatic climate control system in response to feedback regarding air conditioning systems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota's commitment to customer feedback has helped improve vehicles and maintain customer satisfaction.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota has developed several new technologies, including hybrid powertrains, Direct Shift-CVT, Dynamic Force Engines, Toyota Safety Sense, fuel cell vehicles, and autonomous driving technologies.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Toyota vehicles hold their value due to high reliability, customer loyalty, limited supply, and low cost of ownership.
